# Bundled browser libraries

DOMPurify sanitizes rendered Markdown; Marked parses Markdown; highlight.js highlights fenced code. Each library is downloaded from a version-pinned package URL and served locally. Exact versions, source URLs and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in manifest.json. Corresponding licence texts are retained in this directory.

Retain licences when redistributing the project. Review security advisories before upgrading or operating the application long term. No runtime CDN access is required.
